title: Say Uley na Dagem tan Apoy
intro: Ilitrato pa so sakey a dominion ya say dagem et oneebat ed sakey a manuley, ya say boses na sankamelagan iran pinalsa et walaan na belat, tan saray puersa ya ag nanengneng na ordinaryon mata et maalwar ya manlilingkor. Sayan pigura so angitawir na nikadkaduman panarian manlapud sakey ya inad-aro ton akauna, ya walaan na pakayari ed saray elemento tan saray jinn. Balet say baleg ya autoridad et walaan na baleg iran subok — tan say unor a bekta et mangiparungtal na makapakelkelaw nipaakar ed inkagawa na bilay tan patey a mismo.
clues: Atawir ko so baleg a panarian manlapud sakey ya inad-arok ya ateng ya sakey met a propeta tan lingkor nen Allah.
Inikdan ak nen Allah na autoridad ed dagem, ya imbaki to itan ed saray kimey na sakey bulan a biahe ed saksakey a kabuasan.
Anggan say sankamelagan a pinalsa et mansalita nipaakar ed iyasingger ko, tan ontunda ak pian mankelaw ed pakaamta ra.
Indaulo ko so baleg ya armada na saray jinn, totoo, tan manok, ya amin da et akauksoy ed mauksoy iran ranggo ed arap ko.
Walay arawin manoley a sinmabi pian suboken to ak ed panamegley na mairap a angat, tan impaiyakar ko ed korti ko so trono na saman a manoley sakbay ni ingen ya onalagey ed sakey a yurongan so bisita.
Nansiansia ak ya akaalagey, akasandia ed sakey a baston, anggad kinagat itan na melag a pinalsa ed dalin — tan diad saman labat amoria na saramay walad kaliberliber ko ya linmabas ak la.

Say inyabeba ed aralem a bobon nen ugaw ni
Say pangikompronta ed saray managsalamangka na sakey a managpairap a walaan na mamilagro iran tanda
Mansalita manlapud ugaw pian idepensa so kagalangan na ina
Say pangawat ed unor ya niparungtal a kasulatan diad sakey a masanton palandey
trial.answer: Say pangiyakar ed trono na arawin reyna diad panamegley na makapadinayew a paraan

location.answer: Sakey a kiew a baston ya kinagat na anay

options: Sakey a noble ya ombibisitan manuley so angawat na pananisia kayari ton anengneng iray tanda

Inatey ed dayat so sakey a faraon tan say armada to
Say matunong a kaaro et niyatagey ed katawenan

outcome.answer: Sakey a noble ya ombibisitan manuley so angawat na pananisia kayari ton anengneng iray tanda

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
